note: Modoc NF campground on a gentle, shaded slope above Blue Lake, with a boat ramp, fishing pier and swim area. A trail circles the lake, paved between the campground and the boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Blue Lake (Modoc NF): FS page + offices + alerts + rec.gov search + Esri. Open in season; boat ramp was closed July 6-17 2026 for paving. $15 + $5 extra vehicle (max 2) confirmed, mid-May to late October, 14-day limit, 48 sites first-come (group site reservable), vault toilets + water. Not waterfront kept.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: FS says the campground is 'on a gentle slope above' the lake; on Esri the camp area is under continuous dense conifer canopy ~90-180 m from the shore, with no open view corridor. No site map published.

Pin 41.14420,-120.27850 sits by the marshy inlet, ~40 m from the FS lat/lng (41.143761,-120.278988); the loops themselves are hidden under canopy (vehicles visible ~300-450 m WSW at ~41.1426,-120.2820). Not moved: the loop centre can't be fixed from imagery and the FS point agrees with the pin.
